note: Mostly seasonal: about 38 of its 107 sites are sold by the night. Family-run campground just outside Algoma, bordering the Ahnapee State Trail, with a heated pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day), kayak rentals, a jumping pillow and planned weekend activities. --Claude
summary: Operator site + 2024 map read; Campspot not opened. ~107 sites: 33 nightly RV + 5 tent vs ~69 seasonal (~36% nightly) -> keep with the mostly-seasonal line. 30A $50 / 50A $55 + tax: price gate PASSES at exactly $50. Google 4.7 (309). 'Equestrian camping' listed with no horse area on the map - flag. Season 2025 dates only. Not waterfront kept.
flags: LONG-STAY: nightly share ~36% (33 open RV + 5 tent-only of ~107 sites on the 7-23-2024 map; ~69 seasonal). Inside the 10-50% band: kept, note says 'Mostly seasonal: about 38 of its 107 sites are sold by the night'. Posted nightly rates and Campspot booking; no discouraging wording; Google 4.7 (309).

PRICE GATE: PASSES narrowly - cheapest RV night is the 30-amp site at $50 + tax (not over $50). Summer peak $55 + tax (50-amp / 50-amp pull-through); no lower shoulder rate posted. Good Sam stored false (derived, not changed; no Good Sam mention on the site). gateways.py not needed at $50.

HORSE (reviewer): the amenities list says 'Equestrian camping', and the Ahnapee State Trail beside the park allows horseback riding, but the 2024 map draws no horse area or corrals and no horse site type is described on any page. Unknown whether horse campers share the general loops (horse rule) - Campspot site types not read.
SEASON: written 04-22..10-12 from the operator's banner, which still says 'for 2025' in November 2026 - stale-looking; recheck in spring.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived) confirmed; water true written; sewer false (pump-out station and honey wagon, no sewer at sites).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT (two small ponds at the north edge are not a water body for the value; Lake Michigan is several km away through Algoma - no coastal walk).
PHONE (920) 487-3707 and WEBSITE https://www.timbertrailcampgrounds.com/ - confirmed (operator and Google). Note: RV Life's 'Timber Trail Campground' hit (West Bend) is a different park.
